# Christian Trivia V2

> An offline Bible adventure game for kids aged 5 to 10: walk through the seven days of Creation (Genesis 1 and 2),
> answer questions, collect timeline cards. English and Español with read-aloud. Plain JavaScript modules and a PWA,
> no accounts, no tracking. MIT licensed. Owner and author: Mauricio Alonso Moya Tapia.

- Play: https://maumoya.github.io/christian-trivia-v2/
- V1 (the one-day trivia MVP): https://maumoya.github.io/christian-trivia/
